search.heading: Search
search.hint: Every word must appear as a whole word. The newest posts come first.
search.emptyDescription: Type one or more words to find the threads and posts that contain all of them, then narrow it down with the filters.
search.filteredDescription: Try fewer words or remove some filters. Words match whole, so “tomato” does not find “tomatoes”.
search.noResultsDescription: Check the spelling or try fewer words. Words match whole, so “tomato” does not find “tomatoes”.
search.noAuthorDescription: Type the full username of the member, then search again.
search.refusedTitle: This search could not be made
